description: This Java class implements an SNMP transport service for Thingsboard, handling SNMP communication, request scheduling, response processing, and SNMP trap handling within the system.

classes.name: SnmpTransportService
classes.description: Main class providing SNMP transport functionalities including initialization, request scheduling, response handling, and trap processing.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating details of an SNMP request, including request ID, method, response mappings, and response parts.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SNMP transport, thread pools, and configures response mappers and processors.

methods.name: initializeSnmp
methods.description: Sets up SNMP with specified protocol and security configurations.

methods.name: createQueryingTasks
methods.description: Creates scheduled tasks for periodic SNMP querying based on device session context.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends SNMP requests, handling chunked requests if needed.

methods.name: onAttributeUpdate
methods.description: Handles attribute update notifications and triggers SNMP requests.

methods.name: onToDeviceRpcRequest
methods.description: Processes RPC requests to device via SNMP.

methods.name: processResponseEvent
methods.description: Handles SNMP response events, including response collection and processing.

methods.name: processPdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SNMP traps and notifications.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes SNMP responses, invoking response processors and reporting activity.

methods.name: configureResponseDataMappers
methods.description: Sets up response data mappers for different communication specs.

methods.name: configureResponseProcessors
methods.description: Sets up response processors for different communication specs.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the SNMP transport service.
